title: CME Group Expands Nikkei Futures Offerings, Boosts Japanese Equity Derivatives
description: CME Group is expanding its Nikkei 225 futures offerings by introducing yen- and U.S. dollar-denominated Micro Nikkei futures, allowing traders to access the Japanese market more precisely. This move aims to enhance CME Group's current Nikkei futures portfolio and provide global market participants with efficient access to the broader Japanese stock market.
